newsitem.title: UK: Willetts evidence not accurate - UK parly cttee.
newsitem.headline: Willetts evidence not accurate - UK parly cttee.

text.p: The Standards and Privileges Committee of Britain's Parliament on Wednesday strongly criticised junior minister David Willetts.
It said Willetts, when a junior whip, or parliamentary business manager, should not have discussed a sleaze inquiry with the chairman of the committee investigating it.
The committee said Willetts had gone "beyond what should properly have taken place" and it also said it would not accept his evidence given as "accurate".
Immediately after the publication of the report, the Cabinet Office announced that Willetts had resigned.
